sections.overview:
StripchatVR Downloader is a browser extension that allows users to record and download live Stripchat VR sessions in MP4 format. The extension preserves playback metadata during the download process to maintain viewing quality and information. It functions as a dedicated tool for capturing VR video content from the Stripchat platform.
Record live Stripchat VR sessions before they disappear.
Download saved VR recordings from supported model pages.
Preserve VR playback metadata when available.
Choose from various stream qualities.
